name: klubi
description: Lahden Suomalainen Klubi ry — viralliset verkkosivut

scripts.typegen: sanity schema extract --path sanity/extract.json && sanity typegen generate
scripts.migrate:ravintolat: tsx scripts/parse-ravintolat.ts && tsx scripts/import-ravintolat.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-ravintolat.ndjson && tsx scripts/import-kuvat.ts && tsx scripts/patch-ravintola-arviot.ts
scripts.migrate:stadionit: tsx scripts/parse-stadionit.ts && tsx scripts/import-stadionit.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-stadionit.ndjson
scripts.migrate:uutiset: tsx scripts/parse-uutiset.ts && tsx scripts/import-uutiset.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-uutiset.ndjson
scripts.migrate:huuhkajat: tsx scripts/parse-huuhkajat.ts && tsx scripts/import-huuhkajat.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-huuhkajat.ndjson
scripts.migrate:tilastot: tsx scripts/parse-tilastot.ts && tsx scripts/import-tilastot.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-tilastot.ndjson
scripts.migrate:arvokisat: tsx scripts/parse-arvokisat.ts && tsx scripts/import-arvokisat.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-arvokisat.ndjson

scripts.migrate:blogspot: tsx scripts/parse-blogspot.ts && tsx scripts/import-blogspot.ts && tsx scripts/sanity-import.ts data/migration-blogspot.ndjson && tsx scripts/patch-blogspot-links.ts

scripts.migrate:all: npm run migrate:ravintolat && npm run migrate:stadionit && npm run migrate:uutiset && npm run migrate:huuhkajat && npm run migrate:tilastot && npm run migrate:arvokisat && npm run migrate:klubi && npm run migrate:blogspot && npm run migrate:coverage && npm run redirects
